review_independence_note: Role-separated passes shared one orchestration context; they are not claimed as mutually blind or independent review.

MIR.paper: Garikaparthi et al., Methodology Inspiration Retrieval for Scientific Research Problems, ACL 2025, DOI 10.18653/v1/2025.acl-long.1390

IsoSci.negative_history: The frozen benchmark contained a wrong prior dataset reference; preserved by formal erratum.

central_result.name: BENCHMARK_GROUND_TRUTH_FACTORIZATION
central_result.rule: Do not infer structural analogy or target transfer from retrieval relevance alone.

implementation.activation_boundary: No operation can activate retrieval routing, promote canonical knowledge, validate a transfer, or establish intrinsic model improvement.

promotion.operation: non-forced fast-forward of main to exact tested candidate head

saturation.reason: A new ground-truth and corpus-identity coordinate was retained and implemented, while real route performance remains unmeasured.

next_ai.positive: Obtain the exact pinned MIR bytes and execute matched lexical, embedding, domain-stripped relational and graph/structural routes. Promote richer routing only if valid-witness QoIs improve without blocking regressions and with resource attribution preserved.
next_ai.null: If lexical+embedding matches richer routes on valid-witness recall, near-miss rejection, transfer utility and cost, preserve the null and retain the simpler baseline.
next_ai.refuted: If the new benchmark contract misclassifies corpus coverage, label authority or route comparability, preserve the counterexample and revise support only; do not activate retrieval behavior.
next_ai.partial_id: If MIR provides reliable retrieval relevance but not structural ground truth, report retrieval-only performance and freeze a separate structural-witness annotation/probe packet.
next_ai.blocked: If exact corpus bytes/revision, hidden-label isolation, model/evaluator identity or resource sets cannot be established, mark affected trials CANNOT_CHECK.
next_ai.transport: If main moves before a future route candidate promotion, rebuild the candidate against current main without changing the frozen benchmark or erasing the IsoSci erratum.
